verdict.rationale: Xero's first-party reconciliation page says connected bank accounts are reconciled, with JAX categorizing and matching transactions. This covers the core bank-to-ledger matching. The evidence does not show unmatched items or duplicate bank transactions being surfaced for review. The duplicate detection cited is for bills, not bank reconciliation, so it does not count here. missing for 10: surfacing of unmatched transactions for review, duplicate bank-transaction detection, per-account reconciliation review workflow detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: Connect your bank accounts to Xero. Let JAX categorize and match transactions while you're busy with your real work.
JAX, your AI finance partner, reconciles your transactions for you
